description: The root causes repaired by #317 that the near-pole fixture detects separately: the partials enclosed about the patch (the origin placement) and the boundary roots isolated in a patch frame (the tilted placement).

mutants.contract: ADR-0053: a rational patch's partials are enclosed about the patch, not the origin

mutants.diagnostic: intersect: MR PR-317 a plane near the pole of a rational sphere cuts its small circle

mutants.contract: ADR-0053: boundary roots not settled in world axes are isolated in a patch frame
